messages:
jong-plat: Quick heads up — found a reproducible race between TS/Py SDKs and the routing handshake when transient backpressure (429/503) causes retries. clients retry, affinity token races, and requests get mixed onto wrong shard/pool.

maria-devex: ouch. repro steps? :eyes:

jong-plat: minimal repro: 50 concurrent requests, retry=2, induce intermittent 503 on route-policy service. affinity assignment async; retry loses original route-hint.

alex-sdk: paste observed headers?

jong-plat: ```
X-Route-Affinity: hint=pool-A;ttl=30
X-Route-Version: v2
User-Agent: Redwood-TS/1.4.0
```

ria-pm: impact on console: per-route QPS misattribution leads to wrong quota billing and spikes in dashboards.

sam-sre: matches quota dashboard spike this AM. route-v2 rollout + autoscaler churn amplified it.

alex-sdk: options: 1) make handshake synchronous (adds 10-30ms) 2) attach stable client_request_id persisted across retries 3) server accept prior attempt token to map fallbacks.

maria-devex: prefer stable id — small SDK change, long-term win. need to avoid leaking tokens in logs.

jong-plat: prototype trivial. add header X-Client-Request-Id and reuse across retries. server: if sees new affinity after first attempt for same id, map to first route for TTL.

alex-sdk: ensure HTTP client libs don't auto-regenerate id per attempt. set it in SDK wrapper.

jong-plat: TS example:
```ts
const id = opts.clientRequestId ?? uuid()
headers['X-Client-Request-Id'] = id
// ensure retry reuses same id
```
Python:
```py
id = kwargs.pop('client_request_id', uuid4().hex)
headers['X-Client-Request-Id'] = id
# pass through on retries
```

ria-pm: telemetry: surface client_request_id in traces so console can group attempts and show aggregated cost-center.

sam-sre: add metric request_attempts tagged by client_request_id and route_hint. monitor rate of mismatched routing.

alex-sdk: token must be opaque random string, no PII.

jong-plat: opening eng-platform RFC: server accepts X-Client-Request-Id and guarantees stable route mapping for TTL=1m; include defensive toggle for older runtimes.

maria-devex: rollout: opt-in flag in SDK for 1 week, then enable by default next minor. provide opt-out env var.

alex-sdk: PRs: ts-sdk (#1890) py-sdk (#2444) with tests for retry idempotency and opt-in flag.

deploy-bot: rolled route-stabilizer to staging-1 with client_request_id mapping enabled. build #2543. :white_check_mark:

ria-pm: devex please update migration guide and console tile showing grouped attempts.

maria-devex: will add one-pager and console mock. also update telemetry mapping docs.

sam-sre: monitor first 48h post-rollout; alert on per-route cost delta >15%.

alex-sdk: will add changelog migration note for minor behavior change.

jong-plat: thanks team. long-term maybe server-side handshake, but this should fix wrong-pool attribution and quota noise. :rocket:
